summary.text: Stan Gunter was elected to the Georgia House of Representatives in 2020 and represents House District 8.

paragraphs.text: He was raised in Habersham County, earned a chemistry degree from North Georgia College and attended Woodrow Wilson College of Law in Atlanta.

He was district attorney for the Enotah Judicial Circuit from 1999 for 12 years, executive director of the Prosecuting Attorneys' Council of Georgia from 2011, and a superior court judge for the circuit from 2012 until his retirement.
